|lore=The alcoves of Jabba’s palace are good places to make deals and place bets. Jabba gets a cut of the profits, of course.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your unique (•) aliens are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) non-smuggler aliens with printed deploy costs greater than or equal to their printed forfeit are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. May deploy one Attark, Crell, Ghoel, Laudica, Leslomy, Loje, or Vul from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=[[:File:OVS8-04-Bargaining_Table-remaster.webp|Publisher-slip reconstruction]] · [[:File:VS8O-04-Bargaining_Table.png|Publisher slip]].

The complete remastered paper slip and the separate issuer full card are two different witnesses. The gallery retains non-smuggler eligibility and does not print a deploy-phase phrase. Both reduce the opening forfeit bonus and the deploy discount and drop the Jabba’s Palace waiver. The gallery capture date gives no ordering between the two publisher renditions. The existing historical article and route retain their gallery wording. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=44 Normal deployment timing]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071203110141id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v8/ls/bargainingtable.gif Exact issuer gallery capture].
